items.title: Markets extend gains amid Middle East tension; Rupee recovers from fresh low
items.description: Rupee touched a fresh all-time low of 95.43 during the week but staged a strong recovery to end higher, snapping its three-week losing streak.

items.title: S&P 500 rises toward all-time highs on strong jobs
items.description: The advance put the S&P 500 on track for its sixth straight week of gains on bets solid growth will keep powering Corporate America.

items.title: Is SBI stock a good buy after today's 7% decline? Here's a stop-loss for short-term traders
items.description: The sharp decline in SBI stock post Q4 results prompted analysts to advise caution for short-term traders.

items.title: Broader markets outperform; Nifty Midcap 100 hits fresh record high
items.description: The Nifty Midcap 100 index touched a fresh record high of 62,113.85 during the week, while the Nifty Smallcap index moved closer to the 18,800 mark, trading just 2.2% below its all-time high of 19,224.95.
